## File: facebookresearch_edgetam/tools/vos_inference.py

Prompts

```
['run video object segmentation inference on a directory of videos using SAM 2 predictor', 'run VOS inference separately per object for datasets like LVOS or YouTube-VOS', 'load a PNG annotation mask file and extract its color palette', 'save a 2D numpy mask array as a palette-encoded PNG file', 'split a multi-object segmentation mask into a dict of per-object boolean masks']
```

Usage

```
{'run_vos_inference_cli': 'run video object segmentation inference on a directory of videos using SAM 2 predictor', 'run_vos_separate_inference': 'run VOS inference separately per object for datasets like LVOS or YouTube-VOS', 'load_ann_png': 'load a PNG annotation mask file and extract its color palette', 'save_ann_png': 'save a 2D numpy mask array as a palette-encoded PNG file', 'get_per_obj_mask': 'split a multi-object segmentation mask into a dict of per-object boolean masks'}
```
